chapters.title: ADF platform map and the shared lab
chapters.summary: Understand control flow, data movement, transformation compute, and environment boundaries.

chapters.title: Create the factory and navigate authoring, debug, and publish
chapters.summary: Set up the development surface and distinguish code validation from execution.

chapters.title: Azure IR, self-hosted IR, Azure-SSIS IR, and execution location
chapters.summary: Choose the execution plane that can actually reach both ends of the activity.

chapters.title: Linked services, managed identities, SQL credentials, and Key Vault
chapters.summary: Define connections without making runtime input a secret distribution channel.

chapters.title: Datasets, formats, locations, and parameterized paths
chapters.summary: Describe the selected source/sink data and keep transport separate from parsing.

chapters.title: Parameter scopes and deployment versus runtime values
chapters.summary: Know exactly where to define, pass, and read each value.

chapters.title: Expressions: types, interpolation, dates, escaping, and outputs
chapters.summary: Use ADF syntax deliberately instead of mixing pipeline, SQL, Data Flow, and notebook languages.

chapters.title: Variables, counters, arrays, and parallel-loop races
chapters.summary: Keep iteration-local state inside isolated child pipeline runs.

chapters.title: File ingestion: Binary/CSV, hierarchy, wildcards, and completion
chapters.summary: Move a complete immutable delivery into a stable batch destination.

chapters.title: SQL/Oracle/on-prem database ingestion and source load
chapters.summary: Configure query/table reads, runtime routing, and a reproducible extraction boundary.

chapters.title: Incremental watermarks, committed boundaries, and transactional advancement
chapters.summary: Capture a stable interval and move its boundary only after target acceptance.

chapters.title: CDC, hard deletes, soft deletes, and snapshot comparison
chapters.summary: Choose a change/deletion mechanism rather than expecting Copy to infer missing rows.

chapters.title: REST Copy: linked service, dataset, pagination, and JSON mapping
chapters.summary: Copy API rows with the connector's native request and pagination fields.

chapters.title: Web, HTTP Copy, Azure Functions, and custom paging
chapters.summary: Choose a control request versus bulk transfer and make polling finite.

chapters.title: Lookup, Get Metadata, and Filter: output shapes and limits
chapters.summary: Use bounded control metadata without treating it as a bulk-data channel.

chapters.title: ForEach, Execute Pipeline, and child return values
chapters.summary: Pass immutable per-item inputs and wait for real child outcomes.

chapters.title: If, Switch, Until, retries, and error-propagation graphs
chapters.summary: Make failure visible even when logging and cleanup succeed.

chapters.title: Schedule, tumbling windows, storage events, and batch identity
chapters.summary: Use a trigger whose state and retry model match the source delivery contract.

chapters.title: Mapping Data Flow transformations: schema, joins, aggregate, and sink
chapters.summary: Build a managed Spark graph and retain the business grain through transformations.

chapters.title: Data Flow parameters, expression mode, compute, and performance
chapters.summary: Bind runtime inputs while keeping its expression language separate from pipeline syntax.

chapters.title: Databricks, Synapse, SQL, functions, and streaming boundaries
chapters.summary: Use ADF as the orchestrator while keeping compute-specific semantics explicit.

chapters.title: Loading, SQL upsert, deletes, partitions, and idempotent publication
chapters.summary: Define what retrying a load changes before choosing append, overwrite, or upsert.

chapters.title: Security, private endpoints, Purview, RBAC, and diagnostic access
chapters.summary: Keep management permissions, data permissions, networking, and lineage distinct.

chapters.title: Metadata-driven ingestion framework and configuration ownership
chapters.summary: Scale reusable pipelines without giving a control table arbitrary execution power.

chapters.title: Git branches, collaboration, Publish all, and exported ARM
chapters.summary: Review source changes and understand what is actually live in a factory.

chapters.title: Azure DevOps CI/CD: build artifacts, environment overrides, and trigger handling
chapters.summary: Generate once, test the same artifact, and promote it with a controlled release.

chapters.title: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, Bicep, and Terraform alternatives
chapters.summary: Replace the runner without changing the ADF artifact or runtime data contract.

chapters.title: Tests: source contracts, definition validation, integration, and release gates
chapters.summary: Check real data outcomes separately from ADF resource shape and run status.

chapters.title: Monitoring, Log Analytics, Copy bottlenecks, and cost
chapters.summary: Diagnose the slow stage and watch freshness/completeness alongside run status.

chapters.title: Worked lab: parameter isolation, file Copy, rerun, and reconciliation
chapters.summary: Use the validated sample factory and record exact expected results.

chapters.title: Backfill, recovery, region migration, and rollback
chapters.summary: Restore boundaries, identities, triggers, and data—not only the pipeline JSON.

chapters.title: NoSQL, SFTP, nested documents, and cross-cloud source substitutions
chapters.summary: Check each connector's operation/schema contract instead of replacing only a hostname.

chapters.title: Troubleshooting by symptom, parameter, runtime, and graph
chapters.summary: Find the failing layer before resetting state or broadening permissions.

chapters.title: ADF versus Synapse pipelines and Fabric Data Factory
chapters.summary: Use the requested ADF service and plan migrations by capability, not product-name substitution.

scenarios.title: On-prem warehouse migration to Azure
scenarios.summary: Use SHIR, snapshots, CDC, parallel validation and controlled cutover.

scenarios.title: Daily files: 100 million orders by 6 a.m.
scenarios.summary: Use a completion contract, bounded Copy and measured processing capacity.

scenarios.title: Incremental database CDC with hard deletes
scenarios.summary: Choose native CDC or a complete ordered ledger, then commit state and boundary.

scenarios.title: Paginated SaaS REST API to durable landing
scenarios.summary: Configure native pagination or a custom extractor for unsupported contracts.

scenarios.title: SFTP files to ADLS with verified completion
scenarios.summary: Preserve transport identity, host keys and a stable business batch.

scenarios.title: Many tables with metadata-driven parallel ingestion
scenarios.summary: Use bounded Lookup, immutable loop inputs and isolated children/control state.

scenarios.title: ADF orchestration with Databricks or SQL transformations
scenarios.summary: Move sources first and verify external computation outcomes before publication.

scenarios.title: Cosmos/MongoDB documents to header and line facts
scenarios.summary: Preserve source versions/deletes and avoid row multiplication when flattening.

scenarios.title: Kafka/Event Hubs with ADF batch orchestration
scenarios.summary: Keep streaming offsets/state in the streaming engine and give ADF completed handoffs.

scenarios.title: Private source/sink access and governed enterprise pipelines
scenarios.summary: Configure actual execution-plane routes and least-privilege source identities.

scenarios.title: Backfill, source retention gaps and region recovery
scenarios.summary: Restore explicit boundaries, data, control state, identity and scheduler state.

scenarios.title: Dev/test/prod delivery and maintenance
scenarios.summary: Promote the same reviewed ARM artifact with tested parameter and trigger contracts.
